biography.value:
Description

Ixion resembles a unicorn, with a long, golden horn and dark blue skin and gray mane and tail. He has gold bracers on his front legs. The symbol for Ixion and Djose is annotated with the kanji for thunder.

Defense

AC 31, touch 16; flat-footed 23 (-2 size, +7 dex, +1 dodge, +15 natural)

Hp 609 [840] (21d12+168)

Fort +19, Ref +19, Will +14

DR 10/-;

Immune Charm, Confuse, Paralyze, Sleep, Slow, Stun, Death, Doom, Lightning

Resist Fire 20, Wind 10, Shadow 15, Holy 20, Water 10+50%, Ice 15

SR 30

Weakness Earth

Offense

Speed 60 ft.

Melee Gore +28 (2d6+7), 2 Hooves +23 (1d8+3)

Space 15 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

Special Attacks Aerospark, Chaos Charge, Delay Buster, Fulmination Spiral, Lightning Horn, Thor's Hammer, Quick Attack

Statistics

Str 24, Dex 24, Con 26, Int 14, Wis 14, Cha 20

Base Atk +21; CMB +28; CMD 45

Feats Ability Focus (Lightning Horn), Ability Focus (Thor's Hammer), Canny Tumble, Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Improved Initiative, Juke, Just out of Reach, Mobility, Osyluth, Sidestep

Skills Acrobatics +31, Bluff +26, Climb +31, Perception +26

Languages Thorian, Common, Albhedian, Lupin
